notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for an in-app chat/agent (customer support + config assistant). Primary driver is latency SLO for streaming responses and reliable tool-calling to internal ticketing system. Secondary: clear path to Dedicated for predictable throughput during peak business hours.

POC scope: 2 weeks using Hosted API. Goals: 95th perc token latency < 150ms for short-turn responses (<=256 tokens), streaming enabled for partial responses, tool-calling wiring to internal ticketing (via webhook), end-to-end PII redaction demo in logging. Must include examples of log redaction and retention policy enforcement.

Security: Prism Harbor requires SSO/SAML (Okta), SOC2 Type II copy, audit logging (user and admin actions), retention controls (30/90/365 options), KMS integration for key separation, US-only data residency for production. They repeatedly asked: "How are PII fields masked in request logs? Can we opt-out of request logging?" They want explicit confirmation for no org-level request logs with PII and proof of redaction in the pseudonymized logs.

Pricing / commercial: Mid-market sensitivity. Interested in committed Dedicated if unit economics after POC justify it. Initial estimate: $50k-$150k ARR. Price blockers: clarity on per-token cost with streaming and tool-call overheads, and how Dedicated committed throughput pricing compares.

Quoted from Raj (Product): "Streaming makes or breaks the UX — if the assistant feels laggy our CS funnel will drop." From Carmen (SRE): "We need to see end-to-end SSO + audit trails before a procurement approval."

Actions taken: security intake form filed, demo recorded (Fireflies), initial pricing sketch shared. Next: kickoff POC, exchange SAML certs, deliver SOC2 artifacts, show PII redaction sample logs, run throughput test windows.
